verses: To the hunt Shu has gone, And people there are none Remaining in the street. Perhaps a few you'll find; But none like Shu so kind, So graceful, will you meet.
To the chase Shu has gone, And people there are none Left feasting in the street. If find a few you could, Yet none like Shu so good, So graceful, would you meet.
To the fields Shu has gone, And people there are none Careering through the street. Some riders though you told, Yet none like Shu so bold, So graceful, would you meet.
